description: Allows an admitted live/local model to produce a patch *plan* only. The plan is validated, quarantined, and stored as evidence — never trusted. No patch is applied at this rung (not even to a temp workspace). Validated entry shape: {operation: 'replace_file', path: <relative>, new_content: <utf-8 text>}. Only replace_file is supported. Path traversal, NUL-byte content, and oversized entries are rejected with specific status tokens.
purpose: Rung 4 of the live-local-model campaign. Extends the live-model surface to patch plans while keeping the actual application gated. Sets up LIVE_MODEL_TEMP_PATCH_VERIFIER_GATE_LOCK_001 to consume quarantined plans and apply them to temp workspaces only.
invariants: Every QuarantinedPatchPlan carries trusted=False, applied_to_source=False, applied_to_temp_workspace=False.
source_mutation_authorized, corpus_write_authorized, training_eligible are False on every plan.
Unsupported operation (anything other than replace_file) blocks with PATCH_PLAN_BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.
Per-entry > 2 MB or cumulative > 16 MB blocks with PATCH_PLAN_BLOCKED_OVERSIZED.
Empty plan or non-dict entries block with PATCH_PLAN_BLOCKED_SCHEMA_INVALID.
Workspace sha256 tree before==after for every run.
scripts/repair/live_patch_plan_*.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`.
